After the demo release, some bugs were noticed and fixed:
[list]
[*] Minor fix to the Dude's quest
[*] Some hitboxes have been adjusted
[*] Fixed some localization errors

Thank you for your reports about the bugs you've found! If you notice a bug, please send an email to: rohan.denkotea@gmail.com

notes.title: The demo version is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/38fdec092f29d3499c00ffd08932ca0dd1ec15cf.png[/img]

[h2]The demo version is out![/h2]

It took a little longer than I expected, but now the demo is available for download!

The average playtime of the demo is 4-5 hours, which is probably a bit more than the usual 30-minute demo. Whether that's a plus or a minus, I'm not sure, but what's done is done.

After the play-tests, some things were changed, some were removed, some were added, and all that. I'm really hoping to get more feedback from players to improve the game.

The main goal right now is a bit of marketing, after which I'll continue working on the first chapter.

You can find the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239890/Dustopia_Demo/

Thanks for reading this, and I hope you enjoy the demo!
